newsitem.title: USA: EDITEK shareholders approve doubling shrs.
newsitem.headline: EDITEK shareholders approve doubling shrs.

text.p: EDITEK Inc said Friday its shareholders had approved an amendment to its certificate of incorporation, increasing from 30 million to 60 million the number of authorized shares of common stock.
The company said the newly authorized common stock would be available to satisfy previous conversions of EDITEK Series A Preferred Stock.
It said certain holders of the preferred stock had filed suit against the company for its inability to issue conversion shares.
EDITEK Inc has research and manufacturing facilities in North Carolina that provide diagnostic kits for on-site analysis of drugs of abuse and toxins in agricultural products.
